projects.title: Projects
projects.heroTitle: At 4Herfrika, we believe in doing, not just dreaming.
projects.heroDescription: Our programs are grassroots-driven, impact-focused, and designed to connect ambitious women across Africa with real mentorship, networks, and resources. Whether you are pursuing technology, business, medicine, law, agriculture, or any field that shapes Africa's future — we help you navigate your chosen path with confidence, purpose, and the leadership skills to succeed.
projects.introDescription: 4Herfrika is a community of ambitious women making local impacts for global change.
projects.introFullDescription:
4Herfrika is a community of ambitious women making local impacts for global change.
We believe the most powerful lever for change in Africa isn't a single skill — it's access to people who have walked the path ahead.
Whether you're a mentee seeking guidance, a mentor ready to invest in the next generation, or a partner believing in our vision — you're part of a movement that's reshaping what leadership looks like across African campuses.
At 4Herfrika, we give you the skill, the certification, the platform and a support system you need to climb global stages.

colour.label: colour logo
colour.use: Our main logo. Use it on white or very light backgrounds.

navy.name: Navy logo
navy.label: navy logo

onDark.label: on-dark logo

onDark.use: Pink mark with a white wordmark. Use it on navy and other dark brand backgrounds.

white.name: White logo
white.label: white logo
white.use: All white. Use it on dark photos and on coloured backgrounds.

mark.name: Logo mark
mark.label: logo mark

markWhite.name: White logo mark

colours.intro: Select a HEX value to copy it. Each colour also lists its RGB value.

logo.title: Logo colours
logo.intro: The two colours inside the logo. Use them when you need to match the logo exactly, for example in print.

website.title: Website palette
website.intro: The colours used across 4herfrika.org. Use them for web pages, slides and social posts. The website pink is a little deeper than the logo pink.

typography.intro: Two free typefaces from Google Fonts. Outfit does the everyday work and Playfair Display adds a touch of warmth.
typography.viewOnGoogle: View {name} on Google Fonts (opens in a new tab)

outfit.name: Outfit
outfit.note: Use weights 300 to 700. Bold for headings, Regular for body text.

playfair.name: Playfair Display Italic
playfair.note: Use it for one or two words in a heading, never for body text.

usage.intro: A few simple rules keep the logo clear and recognisable.

clearSpace.title: Give it room
clearSpace.text: Keep clear space around the logo equal to the height of the “4”.

minSize.title: Keep it readable
minSize.text: Show the full logo at least 120px wide. Below that, use the logo mark.

onDark.title: Match the background
onDark.text: On navy, dark photos or busy images, use the on-dark or white logo.

distort.title: Don't change its shape
distort.text: Do not recolour, stretch, squash or rotate the logo.

effects.title: No effects
effects.text: Do not add shadows, outlines, glows or gradients.

busy.title: Avoid busy backgrounds
busy.text: Do not place the colour logo on busy photos or on navy. Use the on-dark or white logo instead.

contact.text: Custom sizes, co-branding or a press question? Write to us and we will help.
